name: Afterlife
description: Three pairs back from the other side - cobwebbed bat wings, the bare bones of a dragon and a wraith's drifting shroud. Each one moves with you like the rest of your wings.

name: Shadows & Angels
description: Five pairs of real 3D wings that move with you - a slow, calm wingbeat while you stand, wider strokes as you run, spread wide when you glide.
